render_only_distance_scan_geometry_lod.limitation: Sampled screen-space surface-error test, not a mathematical Hausdorff proof. Original photo UV interpolated through geometric decimation. This is declared render-only mesh LOD for distant visitors, not a replacement or mutating save of source assets. All close people evidence/native/export keep original geometry.
